scope: Publicly discoverable, safely attributable Denton ISD school-specific attendance polygons (not administrative district boundaries or campus points)
directGISAcquisitionOutcome: No district-original GIS export licensed for 2026–27 was obtained. However three official 2026–27 aggregate PDFs are spatially referenced GeoPDFs containing native vector drawing paths; 39 campus GIS candidate polygons were previously derived in QA-only staging, NOT published.

sources.details: 39 individual 2026–27 official school PDFs and three aggregate GeoPDFs, whose native embedded spatial references and drawing paths were used to derive 39 E/M/H staging-only candidate polygons. No authorized or certified production GIS polygons.
External ETStack Web Query linked by Denton ISD; designed for user-entered addresses. No documented public GIS polygon download or approved automated extraction verified
March 24, 2026 Paloma Creek changes impact Bell, Martinez, Sandbrock Ranch, Savannah, Union Park; requires current-year provenance and holdout comparison
Denton Central Appraisal District SchoolDistrict geometry distinguishes ISDs, not individual elementary/middle/high attendance zones
DentonSchools_2023to_2024 reports esriGeometryPoint with school location fields; historical point layer cannot serve school attendance boundaries
NCES SABS school attendance area files stop at 2015–16, cannot certify 2026–27
TEA geographic district data is not school attendance zone evidence

Denton ISD explicitly says the high/middle attendance plan is proposed for 2028–29 only, with no 2026–27 or 2027–28 changes; never treat its map or school forecasts as current 2026–27 assignment polygons

Flower Mound MapServer has polygon geometry and School_District, Elementary, Middle and High attribute fields. It is explicitly restricted to the Town of Flower Mound extent, includes several ISDs, and does not identify verified source school year or 2026–27 Denton-wide changes. This is a separate municipal reference lead, not 39-campus Denton GIS.

releaseGate.mandatory: PR #148 exact residence→official Finder→school→2026–27 per-school polygon holdout
releaseGate.policy: Official PDFs, historic points and district-wide polygons cannot auto-promote Denton to school-level GIS coverage; do not derive geometries from non-exportable Finder without permission.

originalVectorRecordsRequest.recipientRole: Denton ISD public information records office
originalVectorRecordsRequest.requested: existing 2026-27 elementary/middle/high attendance-zone vector GIS, campus IDs, effective year, spatial reference, split-zone exceptions, and redistribution terms
originalVectorRecordsRequest.publicPrivacyGuard: No owner email address, Gmail message IDs, subject or private link in repository
originalVectorRecordsRequest.feeAuthority: No paid request or vendor service without express approval

geoPdfDerivedStaging.nativeGeopdfSpatialReference: NAD83 Texas North Central EPSG:2276 (PDF viewport GEO control points); derived local WGS84 EPSG:4326
geoPdfDerivedStaging.warning: 39/39 is a past QA-only candidate topology and campus-ID check, NOT released 2026–27 attendance GIS or a live acceptance rate.
